data.content_ref: inline:The protocol treats reclamation as deterministic replay from a barrier. Because the crash leaves no terminal record, the audit log may be incomplete relative to the actual workspace state. Replay regenerates an earlier state and overwrites storage, which can silently displace completed evidence that was produced after the last durably logged input but before the crash. A protocol that merely recomputes state does not prevent displacement; it only makes it recoverable, violating the required guarantee.
